notes: EIP1 begins (SSN required for every filer: mixed-status couples and ITIN filers excluded); FPUC 600 starts, but state UI backlogs delayed many first payments to May
FPUC 600 expired after week ending 25 Jul; LWA weeks begin (paid from late Aug)
No federal supplement Oct-Dec 2020 (regular UI, PUA, PEUC only)
EIP2 begins 29 Dec (CAA made mixed-status couples eligible, also retroactively for EIP1)
EIP3 begins 12 Mar (SSN dependants of ITIN filers now eligible)
Early FPUC opt-outs from 12 Jun (TX, FL, GA on 26 Jun)
AZ opt-out 10 Jul; advance CTC begins 15 Jul (child needs SSN)
FPUC, PUA and PEUC end (week ending 4 Sep / 6 Sep)
